patch_description: Apply the recommendation: keep K=8 in the anneal (proven), but add a two-tier greedy polish with K=8 then K=4 and extend polish iterations. This focuses late-stage refinement pressure on the truly smallest triangles: the first tier (K=8) fixes near-minimal triangles broadly, the second tier (K=4) squeezes only the very worst triangles without thrashing on marginal ones. Also increase anneal iterations slightly for better basin escape, since runtime headroom exists (positive score-time correlation). K reduction happens only in greedy polish (monotone accept-only), so it cannot degrade the result.
